title: Preparing for scoped storage (Android Dev Summit '19)
summary: A 2019 Android Dev Summit session on the scoped storage model in Android 10. It gives a plan overview and best practices for apps adapting to the new restrictions.
why: Cited as the official explanation of Google's scoped storage changes and its intent to limit broad file access.

quote.text: This official video is actually a pretty good summary of some the changes made and what the goal is
